post.caption: Golden Globes carpet swallowed a diamond. At the 81st Golden Globes at the Beverly Hilton in January 2024, E News host Keltie Knight was reporting live from the red carpet when she looked down and found a four carat diamond missing from her ring. She said she had it after makeup, when they cleaned it. She posted a photo of herself crawling on the carpet and asked celebrities on Instagram to return it, stressing that it was real. The next day it still had not turned up.
